author: claude-code:preregistered-2026-10-17
statement: Raise location_fit to 0.38 and rescale the others to domain 0.24, skills 0.16, seniority 0.12, experience 0.10, keeping ADR 0003's strict order.
rationale: On real-v1 (assistant-assisted labels) location_fit was the most discriminating factor (factor AUC 0.73) and 96 of 116 reject-labelled jobs passing the gates cited location. These weights were chosen without measuring them on real-v1 and are frozen before any real-v2 label exists.
